**In one line**: OpenAI and Anthropic are reportedly relying on Indian IT services majors TCS and Infosys as key partners to push their AI models into enterprise clients.

### Key points
- Per an NDTV Profit report, OpenAI and Anthropic are using India's TCS and Infosys as go-to partners for enterprise AI rollouts.
- Both firms bring deep global client bases and systems-integration expertise, positioning them to handle the build-and-deploy work of wiring AI models into real corporate workflows.
- The arrangement appears to hand client-specific customization and operational support — hard for model labs to do alone — to the Indian partners.

### Why it matters
The AI race is shifting from raw model performance toward speed of real enterprise adoption. Securing distribution and integration partners is a decisive factor in winning the corporate market, and it signals that India's IT services industry is becoming an execution engine for generative AI at scale.
